candidate.base_probability: strict-prior player Dirichlet posterior with outer-training-only league probabilities and outer-training-only fitted concentration

residual_model.parameter_selection: none; inherited unchanged from the frozen all-prior CatBoost core comparator

candidate.missing_value_policy: native CatBoost missing values for denominator-zero rates; counts and denominators are never imputed
explicitly_excluded: history outcome counts and rates already consumed by the empirical-Bayes offset

spray or pull without a certified coordinate transform
park, weather, umpire, team, market price

base_residual.role: exact rejected residual-control features and unchanged model parameters

chronological_evaluation.algorithm: deterministic expanding split over sorted unique 2023 dates matching sklearn TimeSeriesSplit default boundaries

comparators: exact rejected true-EB-offset residual control refitted within each outer fold
row-wise strict-prior empirical-Bayes player posterior with fitted concentration
row-wise strict-prior empirical-Bayes player posterior with frozen 200-PA concentration
frozen all-prior CatBoost core family refitted within each outer fold

gates.proper_score_materiality: For Brier and log loss separately, candidate-minus-each comparator point estimate and date-block 95 percent upper bound must be below negative one percent of that comparator score for every required component.
gates.discrimination: Candidate AUC must be defined and no lower than every comparator in aggregate and every outer fold for every required component.
gates.calibration: Candidate absolute bias and prediction-decile ECE must be no worse than every comparator for every required component.
gates.hr_high_probability_tail: Candidate top-decile support must contain at least 500 player-games and 20 home runs; calibration gap and proper-score point and upper bounds must be noninferior to every comparator.
gates.chronology_identity_fallback: Every chronology, identity, probability, denominator, missingness, coverage, and no-fallback boundary must pass.
gates.development_only: A 2023 survivor is only a locked research challenger and requires genuinely future untouched evidence for confirmation.
